scope: Offline rescoring of four saved archives; no evolutionary search rerun.
conditions: One record, 5% noise, weak form, 30 epochs, seed 0.

definitions.out: Fit on k-1 slabs; predict each held slab; pool all residual magnitudes / sum(abs(target)).
definitions.one: Fit on each single slab; score its complement; pool residual magnitudes / ((k-1)*sum(abs(target))).
definitions.mean_out_2_4_8: Equal-weight average of the three already-pooled partition scores, with original instability.
definitions.max_out_2_4_8: Maximum of the three partition scores, with original instability.
definitions.vector_out_2_4_8: Three separate pooled partition scores and original instability (four objectives).
definitions.vector_out_and_one_2_4_8: Six pooled protocol/partition scores and original instability (seven objectives; k=2 duplicated).
definitions.vector_two_halves: Separate ab and ba validation errors and original instability.

limits: Saved files contain pooled errors, not individual 4-/8-slab errors or fitted slab coefficients.
These are comparisons against existing archive candidates, not results of a search with new objectives.
Reference-law structures were refitted to noisy data; reported scores do not fix analytical coefficients.
The rational keep-arm archive excludes trig tokens; it is only a historical diagnostic control.
The rational plain-target arm cannot generate the reference's target-related right-hand term.
More objective dimensions can remove dominance without identifying the physical law.
Comparisons retain each equation's original target normalization and instability.
